title: Greek Bean Skillet
description: A hearty, flavorful skillet dish with beans and Greek twist. Serve with crusty bread for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chopped onion and red bell pepper, cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes, kidney beans, and skillet seasoning; stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.
Stir in feta cheese until melted and well combined.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Serve with crusty bread for a filling meal.
